findings.rule: doubt stated: wording only, already raised by the owner's PR #132 review and deferred to the 0.3.7 tag; spec.md Determinism says "a heading per first tag".
findings.summary: The new sentence says the generated index carries "a heading per tag", but `plugin/lessons/index.py` groups only by the first tag (`tags[0]`), so a lesson with several tags gets one heading, not one per tag.

findings.rule: doubt stated: narrow edge case, already raised and deferred by the owner for the 0.3.7 tag — step 0b's instructions only ever write `supersedes` as a bare file name or omit it.
findings.summary: `_supersedes_problem` only validates `supersedes` when it is already a string; a present-but-non-string value (a list or a number) returns `None` and is silently treated as "no supersedes" instead of being reported as malformed.
